items.prompt: Vertical 9:16 KI-channel editorial workspace illustration that feels native inside the existing Remotion reel. Bright white and very light lavender environment, soft purple #B98CFF and deep-purple #6E45C9 accents, clean premium 3D-inspired product-design forms, one central goal card branching into three simple task lanes for web research, document reading and structured notes. Use crisp functional icon-like shapes instead of dense text, soft studio shadows, calm depth, uncluttered composition and generous negative space for native Remotion overlays. The scene should look like an extension of the reel's clean cards, icons and diagrams, not like a separate movie still. No readable UI text, no logos, no human face, no documentary/news look.

items.prompt: Vertical 9:16 KI-channel motion-design B-roll that feels like the moving-media version of the existing Remotion reel. A cursor-like light moves smoothly from node to node while states activate in sequence, with a subtle controlled camera push-in. Keep the frame clean, bright, minimal and readable so Remotion UI overlays can sit on top naturally. No dramatic film lighting, no dark set, no realistic documentary feel, no logos, no readable screen text, no subtitles, no human faces.
